tagline: Small livestock, big lessons. Shrimp, snails, bettas, quail, mushrooms, microgreens and more, every episode and Short from the channel.

guides.title: What Grows Here
guides.body: Micro Farmer covers small livestock and small space growing: shrimp, snails, frogs, betta fish, crayfish, crabs, worms, tilapia, quail, bees, mushrooms, microgreens, and hydroponics and aquaponics. The Shrimp Farmer series lives inside this channel. If it is small, productive, and fits a homestead corner, it belongs here.

guides.title: Where To Start
guides.body: New here? Start with the Videos for the full builds and setups, then use the Shorts for quick checks and updates on the tanks and trays. Search the list by animal or crop name and every matching episode and Short lines up in order.

guides.title: How To Use This App
guides.body: Every video on the channel is listed here, newest first. Search by a word in the title. Tap any video to watch it on YouTube, and tap the star to save a favorite. The list refreshes itself from the channel feed when you open the app, so new videos appear here with no app update.
